company.name: Sallaty For Technology
company.shortDescription: Sallaty For Technology is an online shopping website that offers retail products.
company.description:
Sallaty.jo is an online Shop where variety & quality meets. Sallaty Consists of 3 main departments: Market, Electro and Plus, trying to make Sallaty the first option that comes to customers mind when they think of online shopping. 
Sallaty.jo's mission is to help the families live easier, happier and less stressful lives by providing the most convenient shopping experience with the biggest variety of affordable high quality retail products online. 
Sallaty.jo is doing this through selecting the best suppliers and through providing excellent friendly customer service and timely delivery of goods to the place of its customers’ choice.
